summary: # What makes a good fuzz target This document explains the concept of a *fuzz target* and gives advice on how to make your fuzz targets really good. # Basics A *fuzz target* is a function that accepts an array of bytes and does something interesting with these bytes using the API under test. We define a specific signature for fuzz targets: ```cpp // fuzz_target.cc extern "C" int LLVMFuzzerTestOneInput(const uint8_t *Data, size_t Size) { DoSomethingInterestingWithMyAPI(Data, Size);
type: skills
